backgrounds.description: Red neon city street - Main Hero Background

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use 'Chakra Petch' or 'Rajdhani' from Google Fonts. Add the import link in index.html.
CRITICAL: Force Dark Mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle. The game is strictly dark.
CRITICAL: Use sharp corners (rounded-none) for ALL components (buttons, cards, inputs). This is a strict design rule.
CRITICAL: Use the 'Red Neon' (#FF003C) sparingly as an accent color for active states, primary buttons, and critical alerts.
CRITICAL: Implement a 'Sidebar' for desktop and 'Bottom Navigation' for mobile. Use media queries to switch.
CRITICAL: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numerical data (money, stats, heat).
CRITICAL: Add a subtle 'scanline' overlay or noise texture to the background to give it a retro-terminal feel.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements must have a hover state that involves a color shift or a slight translation (glitch effect).
CRITICAL: Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Style them with the primary neon color.
CRITICAL: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast. Use #E0E0E0 for body text, not #FFFFFF (too harsh).
CRITICAL: For the 'City Map', use a grid of interactive 'Neighborhood Cards' rather than a literal map image, fitting the text-based RPG style.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) but keep it dark/tinted.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
